title: Read DeepVigor+ primary paper and summarize its method and scope
notes: Read the complete 15-page arXiv v2 paper dated 2025-10-26, including limitations and references; inspected original Tables V-VIII. Method estimates clean-prediction changes under single FP32 weight or activation flips using error bins, threshold search, and stratified sampling. Validation uses six CNNs; Table III compares full analysis with exhaustive weight injection in 15 percent of channels. Verified reported 0.819-0.978 percentage-point mean vulnerability error, 14.9-26.9 fold reduction in simulation count, and roughly 9-46 minute sampled runtimes on A100. Does not establish budgeted multi-fault protection performance or transformer support. No manuscript or experiment changes.
